sample_unit: patients with acute ischemic stroke presenting to spoke hospitals

links.outcome: Rate of transferred stroke patients treated with EVT before vs after AI implementation
links.effect: EVT rate among transfers rose from 32.1% pre-AI to 45.7% post-AI (p=0.02); adjusted OR 1.85 (95% CI 1.12-3.06). Non-randomized pre-post design; outcome is a process measure rather than patient outcomes.
links.quote: The rate of transfers treated with EVT significantly increased (32.1% pre-AI vs. 45.7% post-AI, p = 0.02).

unlisted_practices: AI-enabled image sharing and messaging between spoke and comprehensive stroke center hospitals to guide transfer decisions
Estimating transfer cost and payor savings from AI-guided triage

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical and economic impact of deploying Viz LVO software across a multi-hospital spoke network before and after implementation, without comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
